name: Henzie "Toolbox" Torre
oracle_text:
Each creature spell you cast with mana value 4 or greater has blitz. The blitz cost is equal to its mana cost. (You may choose to cast that spell for its blitz cost. If you do, it gains haste and "When this creature dies, draw a card." Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.)
Blitz costs you pay cost {1} less for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.

needs.what: the blitz alternative cost (702.152) as a card-level cost and as a player-wide static granting it to a class of spells (affects_spells: creature, mana value >= 4), with the price 'equal to its mana cost'; when paid, the permanent gains haste and "When this creature dies, draw a card." and is sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step, plus a `blitzed` condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No `blitz` in card_level_cost_keys and no granting static: `granted_alternative_cost` takes only pay_energy/pay_life and has no rider, and `grant_warp` exiles at end step and grants neither haste nor the dies-draw trigger; approximating with those would change the card

needs.what: a player-wide reduction that applies only to blitz costs being paid, by {1} per `commander_casts_this_game` for you
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `spell_cost_reduction` filters spells by characteristics, not by which alternative cost is paid; there is no blitz cost for it to key on (`plot_cost_reduction` is the analogue for plot only)
